description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor' which provides a base for processing registration events within the OrangeHRM system. It manages registration event data, interacts with services and DAOs, and handles event publishing, but does not implement specific event logic itself.

classes.name: AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor
classes.description: An abstract base class for processing registration events in OrangeHRM. Provides methods for saving events, gathering registration data, preparing publish data, and abstract methods for event-specific details.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventQueueDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO responsible for registration event queue operations.

methods.name: getRegistrationAPIClientService
methods.description: Returns the service used for communicating with the registration API.

methods.name: getOrganizationService
methods.description: Returns the service for organization-related data.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves a registration event if applicable.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventGeneralData
methods.description: Gathers general information about the registration event, including admin info, system configuration, and organization details.

methods.name: processRegistrationEventToSave
methods.description: Creates a RegistrationEventQueue object populated with event data and timestamp.

methods.name: publishRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Publishes unprocessed registration events to an external API if in production mode.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventPublishDataPrepared
methods.description: Prepares event data for publishing by adding event type and time.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Abstract method to be overridden to specify event type.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Abstract method to be overridden to provide event-specific data.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the event should be saved.
